therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Dual tyrosine kinase inhibition of ErbB1 and ErbB2 receptors
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Inhibition of tumor cell proliferation and survival signaling through ErbB receptor pathways
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Women with advanced or metastatic breast cancer receiving first-line therapy

results.effect_size: HR 0.87 (95% CI: 0.72-1.05) by investigator assessment; HR 0.82 (95% CI: 0.65-1.04) by IRC
results.target_engagement_evidence: ErbB2 amplified tumors present in 45 lapatinib vs 35 placebo patients; serum ErbB1/ErbB2 levels measured
biomarker_changes: ErbB2 amplification detected by FISH in subset of patients
Serum ErbB1 and ErbB2 concentrations monitored
subgroup_findings: Higher response rates in lapatinib arm (102 CR+PR vs 73 CR+PR)
safety_signals: Serious adverse events: diarrhea (24 vs 2), febrile neutropenia (10 vs 3)
results.dose_information: Oral lapatinib with paclitaxel, specific dosing not provided in results

context.duration: Average 26 weeks treatment, 24 months overall survival follow-up
